1. Purpose of the Application
Achordpany helps users search for song lyrics and guitar chords based on lyrics sung or heard. It streamlines the process by identifying the closest match without needing to enter song titles.

2. Key Features and Benefits
- Access to guitar chords and lyrics.
- One-click music identification.
- Real-time matching based on input melody or background audio.

3. Use of the Application
Achordpany is for personal, non-commercial use only.
Users are responsible for input accuracy. While we strive for the best match, we cannot guarantee perfection.
Some links may lead to external sites; we are not responsible for third-party content.

Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when using our application. By using Achordpany, you consent to the practices described in this policy.

Information Collection and Use
Achordpany collects data necessary to provide an accurate and user-friendly experience. This may include:
  • Voice Inputs: To identify songs and retrieve lyrics and chords, Achordpany may temporarily process your voice or audio data.
  • User Data: We may collect general usage data to improve app performance, such as interaction frequency or features accessed. All information is processed to enhance your experience and is stored only as long as necessary.

Data Security
We prioritize protecting your information. Achordpany uses industry-standard measures to safeguard data against unauthorized access or misuse. However, while we strive to keep your data secure, please be aware that no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

Third-Party Links
Achordpany may link to third-party websites for song lyrics and chords. We do not control these sites and are not responsible for their privacy practices. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party sites you access through our app.

Children’s Privacy
Achordpany is not intended for users under the age of 13, and we do not knowingly collect data from children. If we discover that we have inadvertently collected such information, we will promptly delete it.

Data Retention
Achordpany retains collected data only as long as necessary to fulfill the app’s purpose or comply with legal obligations. Once data is no longer needed, we ensure it is securely deleted.

Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update our Privacy Policy periodically. We recommend checking this page for any changes. Continued use of Achordpany after modifications constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

Contact Us
For questions about this Privacy Policy or data practices, please reach out to us at support@achordpany.com.

By using Achordpany, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to this Privacy Policy.

About Achordpany

Achordpany is your go-to app for effortlessly finding guitar chords and lyrics — even if you don’t know the song title. Whether you’ve got a melody stuck in your head or hear something playing nearby, Achordpany helps you identify the song and instantly view its chords.

What You Can Do with Achordpany:
- Identify songs by singing, humming, or letting the app listen
- Instantly access guitar chords and lyrics
- Save your favorite songs for quick access later
- Explore new music and practice your playing with ease

Our goal is to make learning and playing music fun, intuitive, and accessible for everyone — from beginners to seasoned players.

Why We Built It:
Because we know how frustrating it is to have a tune in your head and no idea what it is. Achordpany bridges that gap — letting you go from inspiration to jamming in seconds.

Get in Touch:
We’d love to hear your feedback, suggestions, or song requests!
Email us at: support@achordpany.com

Happy strumming!
